## BackingMinds Invest AB

### What the company does
BackingMinds is a **Nordic venture capital firm** that invests in early-stage technology companies. It focuses on backing founders outside traditional VC networks, with investment themes spanning **climate & resilience, AI & digital sovereignty, and human potential**. The firm uses data-driven sourcing methods to identify opportunities, with a particular emphasis on entrepreneurs who may be overlooked by conventional investors — including founders based outside major cities, women, and people with immigrant backgrounds. About 43% of the founders it has backed are women, 43% have immigrant backgrounds, and over 70% were founded outside Stockholm and Copenhagen.

### Headquarters
**Stockholm, Sweden** — Strandvägen 7A, 114 56 Stockholm.

### Founded
**21 April 2016**, by Sara Wimmercranz and Susanne Najafi.

### Employees
The most recent available figure shows **5 employees**. (Earlier years reported 0–4.)

### Funds raised (as a VC firm)
BackingMinds is not a startup raising venture rounds for itself — it is a **fund manager** that raises capital from limited partners (LPs) to invest in startups. Its fund history:

- **BackingMinds Invest I** — first fund (details on size not publicly specified in available sources).
- **BackingMinds Invest II** — **€50 million** fund, expanded across the Nordics with a focus on Denmark.
- **BackingMinds Invest III** (latest) — achieved a **first close of more than €50 million (~$56.1 million)** in October 2026. The European Investment Fund (EIF) committed €20 million. Notable new investors include Mojang (Minecraft) co-founder Carl Manneh, Candy Crush maker King co-founder Sebastian Knutsson, H&M heir Karl-Johan Persson, and EQT founder Conni Jonsson. The fund targets 15–20 companies in AI, climate, and resilience.

Estimated **assets under management** are over **$63.6 million**.

### Latest funding activity
The most recent milestone is the **first close of BackingMinds Invest III** at over **€50 million**, announced in **October 2026**. The fund is still raising and has not yet announced a final close.
